description: This script automates the generation of markdown documentation files from header and JSON files for plugins, specifically within a project that handles API documentation. It includes functions for converting header files to markdown, converting JSON plugin descriptions to markdown, postprocessing markdown files for link adjustments, and orchestrating these processes through command-line arguments.

methods.name: generate_md(logfile=None)
methods.description: Generates markdown files from header files or JSON for all plugin folders in the 'apis' directory.

methods.name: convert_json_to_md(plugin_path)
methods.description: Converts plugin JSON files into markdown documentation using an external script.

methods.name: convert_h_to_md(plugin_path, logfile=None)
methods.description: Converts header files within a plugin directory into markdown documentation by calling an external script.

methods.name: postprocess_md()
methods.description: Post-processes generated markdown files to clean up and fix links.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point for command-line execution, orchestrating the documentation generation and postprocessing steps.
